# AiLovePDF

> 100% Free. Truly Private. Your files never leave your device.

[AiLovePDF](https://www.ailovepdf.site/) is a free online PDF toolkit with a zero-upload architecture: every tool runs entirely in the visitor's web browser using client-side JavaScript. PDF files are opened, processed and saved on the user's own device — they are never uploaded to, transmitted to, or stored on a server. There is no PDF-processing backend.

Canonical website: [https://www.ailovepdf.site/](https://www.ailovepdf.site/)
Brand page (what makes AiLovePDF different): [Why AiLovePDF](https://www.ailovepdf.site/why-ailovepdf/)

## Key facts

- 100% free: every tool is free to use, with no premium tier required for the listed tools.
- No sign-up: no account or registration is needed.
- No uploads: files are processed locally in the browser and never leave the user's device.
- No watermarks on output files.
- Works on mobile and desktop in any modern browser (Chrome, Edge, Firefox, Safari).
- Available in 6 languages: English, Spanish, French, German, Brazilian Portuguese and Arabic.
- Publisher: AiLovePDF. Contact: [Contact AiLovePDF](https://www.ailovepdf.site/contact/)

## How it works

AiLovePDF's tools load JavaScript libraries into the browser once; after that, all PDF operations (merging, compressing, splitting, rotating, converting) happen on the user's device with no server round-trip for the document itself. Because no file is transmitted, the tools are suitable for sensitive documents such as contracts, bank statements and ID copies, subject to the user's own device security.

For current tool availability, supported file types, limits and privacy details, use the individual tool pages and the site's Privacy/Terms pages as the authoritative sources.
